items.title: Tell us about your symptoms online
items.copy: You can now tell us about your symptoms online, any time. A doctor or nurse reviews every request and replies within one working day.

items.title: Welcome to Dr Amara Osei
items.copy: Dr Osei joins the practice team with a special interest in women's health and long-term conditions.

items.title: Blood test clinics moving to mornings
items.copy: From July, blood test appointments run 8am to 12 noon to get samples to the lab on the same day.
